content: Jises mesekei ndramak ari badan imek amwenen ja
Jises sandroh i bolo ndron ra-ei, ma iy iu i hamon i kapa gwa bilisiu ili kon tan amwenen.

Eme ma, iri lau ra-on bwese-ei ndramak ari badan imek ta eme atou iy. Ndramak nane amadin bada nyahan tan. Jises atou buku none budon toro boto-on labai in tan, ma iy tiye i ta ndramak nane badan imek anya, “Ou abadok, naduk! Kandriyen ndra-in tam ndrasikinei ndra-au.”
Eme ma oro lau ra-on ta leheya kandriyen malen nunu-uh i buku doh, “Ndramak kede-eh asehek sahou ndra-in i bada Kindrei.”
Arile, Jises tanan budon toro ma iy anya, “Tasah handru ado abudon ndra-in i buku badeh in bolo ndrine ado?
Buku sah, san manamun ndraheh, jo kasehek anya, ‘Kandriyen ndra-in tam ndrasikine ndra-au,’ deh bwe, katiye, ‘Ou suri ou, ma ou adek’?

Jo winiyan leheya ewek tado ma ado ki tana ado, ta Nadu Ndramak Awas badeh, boto-on labai, udu bwele-e munyak dah ta tiye i ta ndramak ta mani kandriyen ndra-in tan iu.” Eme ma iy tiye i ta ndramak nane badan imek, iy anya, “Ou suri ou, ma ou andrei nyahan tam ma ou au a kon!”
Ndramak nane suri iy eme loken, ma iy iu i kon.
Eme ma, iri lau mari nane atou, ma iri anoh, ma iri atudun nyara Kindrei, tasah Kindrei badeh, edeu iri boto-on i buku doh ili tiri lau mwan ma badih.
Jises aloh Metiu
Eme ma Jises edek ili, ya iy atou ndramak ari nyaran Metiu manyah ereu bolo asiu tan ta gok ta akohok luk ta takis, eme ma iy tiye i tan, “Ou ame an hamon tek.” Eme Metiu suri iy ma iy in hamon tan.
Ano, Jises manyah udu bolo asiu ta Metiu. Ya iri lau solo-an ta akohok luk ta takis, ma hawe iri Juwis ale ba-en hamon ta kandriyen ta batanau ta Moses bwe, ame aimon nyamon hawen, ma oro lau tan.

Eme oro Parasi atou, ma oro orou sahou i ta Jises, ma oro tiye toro lau tan buku doh, “Tasah handru ndramak ta leheya tado aimon nyamon hawe oro lau ta akohok luk ta takis, ma hawe oro lau ale ba-en hamon ta batanau ta Moses bwe?”
Jises anuhun sahou toro, ma iy tiye, “Iri lau ale babo sik bwe, iri winiyan baso-ok ndramak ta anyumor bwe. Arile, iri lau tiri sik le badeh, aseken seben.
Ado kala kabudon kati sahou sokek dah kamwenen,

content.text: ‘Jo baso-ok salom laleyah aha amekes eme tek bwe,
arile jo aso-ok handru aha kamekes kandriyen ta tikisiy ki ta ndramak ari ja.’” Hoseya 6:6

content: Eme Jises anya ja, “Jo eme dah ta aseben lau mwasin le, bwe. Jo eme dah badeh, ta aseben iri lau ta karei ma lomondra ndra-in udu tiri kasahan mwasin.”
Jises leheya tanan ta amekes beleben ta nyamon

Jises hawe oro lau tan aimon nyamon kahis le badeh, oro lau ra-on ta Jon ta alomwa ame ndremenya iy i buku doh, “I buku sah handru ahi lau ta Jon hawe oro Parasi abeles ahi ta nyamon, ya oro lau tam bwe?”

Eme Jises asumon i buku doh, “I buku none ndramak tasou bolohau udu aliy, ado winiyan babilisi oro lau ta molak bwe! Arile, na len hamon eme kameh, iri lau ta kaliu tan kuhi iy eme len, ma oro kameh, winiyan baimon nyamon bwe, oro kameh beleben, ma abeles oro ta nyamon.

“Ado kanuhun. Ari ndramak winiyan bakuhi ranah kolau ha-un, ya suwidiy ja i manamunu awin malen bwe. Buku iri bwidiy i buku doh, ya iri sikine awin, kolau ha-un nane kameh bosokou, ma awin malen kameh atarah ja, eme ma, munun kameh i tinan labai ja.

Ari ndramak winiyan basukuni waen ha-un bala bolo ku-i me malen bwe. Buku none iy amekes i buku doh, waen doh kameh tuburok, ma kohan kameh tarani ku-i me nane, ma waen kamou, ma iu laleyah. Ma ku-i me ale kameh andra-i. Arile, iri lau asolou waen ha-un i bolo ku-i me ale ma bweseken kahis le, ma uru ma la-uh kameh ado mwasin.”
Jises mete-ei nadu nah ari ma mesekei badih ari tawi awin tan amwenen ja

Jises asehek sahou ili toro lau ta Jon kahis le, ndramak ari tinan ta atondrok eme atehei bwili ndru-un ere mirihik ta kati Jises, ya iy tiye i buku doh, “Naduk badih ndramak na nane, arile jo aso-ok ou ame atehei le minem le ki tan, ya iy kamak ja.”
Iy tiye ano le badeh, Jises suri iy, ma iy in hamon tan, ma oro lau tan ale an hamon tan.

Oro adek ala badeh, iy badih ari ja ereu san, sik ndra udu tan winiya jaha ronoh la-uh. Iy badih doh sokohani iy i ndrokowa iri lau ili in hamon ta Jises, ma iy abudon i buku doh, “Buku none jo katawi le kiri awin tan, sebwe jo winiyan amwenen.” Eme ma, iy atehei minen le i ta kiri awin ta Jises.

Arile Jises tubuni iy, iy atou badih doh, ma iy anya, “Ou sabudon sandra-i, ndri-iy, naduk. Ou atehei budon tam handru in tek, ma mesekei ou asahan amwenen.” Eme na le liliy, sik tan ano, ma iy asahan amwenen.
Hamon ta aliy, Jises eme asahan asiu ta ndramak tinan nane. Eme iy atou iri lau ta kabek aden areu aliy. Iri lau doh oloh bala-eu, ma iri taya andra-i labai.
Eme Jises tiye i toro i buku doh, “Ado ka-au ka len. Iy nadu badih kede-eh bamak bwe, iy asah amadin le kede-eh.” Iri anuhun sahou tan, ma iri ehe-en iy andra-i labai.
Arile Jises abadok, ma tikahei iri ala manan. Eme ma iy ili bolo asiu, ma iy tawi mine nadu badih nane, ma iy amak ja.
Eme ma, sahou nyala lakou nane Jises mesekei aseker i bolo kon loboho nane doh.
Jises mesekei uru lau ma la-uh mada uru bwe, ma ndramak ari bohon bwe amwenen ja
Jises ruwani kon nane, ma iy edek ili, ma uru lau la-uh mada uru bwe adek an hamon tan, ma uru aloh i tan anya, “O nadu tubu kabin Debit,
ou tikisi aru!”

Jises ili bolo asiu ra-em, ma uru lau ma la-uh nane ame hawen. Ma iy ndremenyani uru, “Ah atehei budon boto-on handru ta jo winiyan mesekei ah amwenen deh bwe?” Ma uru anya, “Ehe, Laban, aru atehei budon taru handru.”
Eme Jises atehei minen i mada uru, ma iy anya, “Ah atehei budon boto-on in tek, ma lakou mwasin nane ah aseken kasahan ta ah.”
Se nawin bwe mada uru asak. Arile, Jises atehei sahou boto-on anya, “Ah sasehek nyala ari lau ja, ta lakou asahan ta ah dah, ndri-iy.”
Arile, uru ala asehek nyala lakou nane Jises mesekei asahan turu ili nyala iri lau mari badu loboho kon tinan nane doh.
Kala le uru lau mala-uh nane ruwani Jises, oro lau ra-on kuhi ndramak ari bohon bwe, ma malawin ndra-in ereu la-un.

Eme ma Jises tikahei malawin ndra-in nane iu, ma ndramak nane bohon bwe asehek sahou ja. Eme ya iri lau mari mani iri atur labai, ma anya, “Aden! Bwena mene ari lakou buku doh basahan bolo kon tinan Isra-el bwe, handru en!”
Arile, iri Parasi anya, “Iy atikah malawin ndra-in iu tasah, tinan tiri malawin ndra-in badeh, edeu boto-on ili tan ta amekes lakou doh.”
Jises tikisi handru iri lau mwan ma badih

Hamon ta aliy, Jises edek ili bolo iri kon tinan ma bwisik mari, ma iy leheya iri in bolo asiu ta atukum tiri. Iy atiye sahou mwasin ta Kindrei aso-ok iri lau mwan ma badih, ma iy aso-ok iri kame baha tondrok mwasin tan. Ma Jises ale mesekei iri lau mari tiri sik in bada iri amwenen ja.
Eme Jises atou iri lau solo-an labai atukum, ma iy tikisi iri. Tasah, budon tiri inyon laleyah ta san ta takaleh Kindrei, ma iri ado ndra-in labai, buku none sipsip lau ta atondrok iri bwe.
Eme ma Jises tiye toro lau tan anya, “Ado katou, nyamon solo-an labai ndruni in bolo bilin, arile lau solo-an bwe, ta gok ta akohok nyamon nane doh bwe.
Eme ya ado kasolom ki ta Laban ta kati bilin, ta iy kasuni lau kala katukumwi iri nyamon tan.”

footnotes.text: Udu bolo len doh, kon ta Jises badeh, Kapena-um.

Iri Parasi badeh, a-en hamon ta kandriyen malen solo-an labai, eme iri anya iri are lau ba-en hamon tiri kandriyen malen solo-an doh, iri asahan lau ndra-in ma iri ado ndra-in ta mada Kindrei. Ma iri Parasi anya, buku ndramak ari ja ili hawe ndramak ndra-in doh, iy ale asahan ndramak ndra-in. Iri Parasi anya ja, iri lau ta akohok luk o takis, iri badeh ndra-in ale, tasah san solo-an iri ado hawe iri lau leheleh badu Rom.

Iri Juwis badeh, adi me, ta akohok ku-in ma asowek. Ku-in doh kameh, iri suwidiy i buku sabok laba tinan ta asolou ndraye waen ili bolon. Iri atehei waen ha-un ili bolo ku-i iri me nane doh badeh, iri atehei udu gwek luluwen sese o winiya len sabe op, ta nyiminye waen kasahan kamwenen. Ta bolo oro len doh, waen kameh winiyan apus eme loken ma tabasi bwisi iri waen nane ndrabosar mwena udu aliy.

Iri Juwis badeh, tanan buku, ndramak Kindrei badeh, ndranyowaniy ta akohok iri mwan ma badih tan, iy kameh asahan amwenen boho kamen ta kabin Debit. Uru lau ma la-uh, mada uru kaseu atehei budon turu i buku, iy Jises le doh badeh, iri Isra-el ale atondrok iy kede-en, ma uru aloh Jises i buku doh, Nadu tubu kabin Debit.
